title: ひとつとや (Hitotsu to ya — New Year Counting Song)
description: A New Year counting song (お正月の数え歌) traditionally sung while drinking otoso (お屠蘇) spiced sake on New Year's morning. Each verse uses the old-style Japanese counting words (ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ…) paired with a wish or prayer for the coming year: peace, prosperity, good health, a growing household, and an uneventful year. Documented in the Meiji era (1892 collection); anonymous traditional song sung across many regions with regional lyric variation.
license: Public Domain (anonymous traditional folk song, documented 1892 — no identifiable rights holder)
